name: Lithuania: check of forms and supplied documents

common.check: Trial title and EU trial number (if assigned) match the protocol and CTIS.
Every field the assistant answers is answered; fields that belong to the site, investigator, insurer or sponsor are left empty, not invented.
Signature as required: signed before upload only where Lithuania requires it (M2 declaration of interest, N1 site suitability statement) or the selected form or law calls for it; otherwise unsigned.
CTIS title follows the naming guide and requirements.json; correct CTIS location.

LT-K1.check: Uses the EU template version 2.0 (new Part II submissions from 1 September 2026) or an equivalent format covering all required information, with Lithuania-specific information in Lithuanian.
Explains how, when and where potential participants are approached, how privacy is protected, how much time they receive to decide, how understanding is checked and how withdrawal is handled.

Yes/no answers for incapacitated adults, minors, impartial witness and emergency match the project's populations; each 'yes' section is completed with the Lithuanian national fields, each 'no' section says not applicable.

Minors: under-12 oral information (whether written information is also given; information and the child's opinion documented), 12-plus oral and written information and assent, both-parent consent and exceptions, dissent, re-consent at adulthood.
Limited-capacity adults: categories of legally entitled representative and how authority is verified; capacity assessment; adapted information; dissent; re-consent when capacity is regained.
Impartial witness: reason, eligible participants, witness selection, communication of information, alternative consent method, who signs and dates, copy to the participant.

Emergency: why prior consent is impossible, recognition and documentation of the emergency, prior-objection check, why a representative cannot be reached, information after the intervention, who seeks consent to continue, later refusal.
Advertising explanation (need, placement, ineligible respondents, reimbursement, respondents' personal data) and healthy-volunteer identification and screening.
Handling of people who do not understand Lithuanian is defined in advance.
Electronic consent: legal validity of the signature method established.
Recruitment routes match the recruitment material (K2) and the protocol; consent pathways match the L1 sets.

LT-SITE-LIST.check: Every planned Lithuanian site listed with the principal investigator, the investigator's position and the expected number of participants.
Matches the CTIS site data, M1, M2 and N1; no participant signatures.

LT-M-QUALIFICATION.check: Describes the investigators' qualifications and contains the sponsor statement that they comply with the Clinical Trials Regulation and Lithuanian requirements.
ICH E6(R3) training documented for all investigators; GCP training certificate for investigators without medicinal-product clinical trial investigator experience in the previous five years.
Consistent with the CVs (M1) and the site list.

LT-M1.check: One current CV per principal investigator and site.
Shows qualification and relevant clinical and trial experience; personal details supplied by the investigator, nothing invented.

LT-M2.check: One declaration per principal investigator and site; interests answered by the investigator.
Signed and dated by the principal investigator before upload (Lithuanian national Part II list).

LT-N1.check: One statement per Lithuanian site; covers facilities, equipment, procedures and human resources (Annex I point 67) and is specific to this protocol.
Issued by the head of the clinic or institution at the trial site, or that person's delegate.
Signed and dated before CTIS submission; the assistant did not fill the signature block.
Site capabilities marked for the site to confirm; site facts not invented.

LT-O1.check: Civil liability insurance certificate or policy, or other proof of indemnification, demonstrating the applicable cover.
Corresponds to the Lithuanian trial, the sponsor, the investigators and the covered activities.
Insurance wording in every participant document matches it.

LT-P1.check: Describes reimbursement of participant costs and any compensation for time; amounts, conditions and recipients identical to every participant document.
When time is compensated, the ICF states an approximate hourly amount.
Contraception costs compensated where contraception is required specifically because of the trial.
Minors and incapacitated adults receive only compensation for expenses and loss of earnings directly related to participation.

LT-P2.check: Covers trial financing, financial transactions, compensation to participants and to the investigator or site, and other relevant financial agreements with the site.
Participant reimbursement matches P1 and the ICF.

LT-FEE.check: Proof that the applicable Lithuanian state fee has been paid, for this application (initial authorisation or substantial modification).
Uploaded in the CTIS proof-of-payment location.

LT-R1.check: Sponsor statement that trial data will be collected and processed in accordance with the GDPR; sponsor details match the CTIS application.
No national data-protection sentence added (none required); consistent with the privacy information in the participant documents.

LT-S1.check: New and archive sample sections match the protocol and sample plan; at least one is completed.
Shows compliance with Lithuanian rules for collection, storage and future use of biological samples.
Sample types, storage locations, retention, future-use purpose, transfers and destruction or withdrawal agree with the participant information and any future-use consent.
Future use outside the protocol is answered consistently with the separate future-use ICF or opt-in choice.
